versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the trpg-maps-update skill.
- Supports updating or fixing the map system within briefing_package projects.
- Introduces dedicated maps/ directory for large map YAML files (over 80 lines).
- Moves large maps from data/ to maps/ to improve efficiency and avoid excessive token usage.
- Updates scene YAMLs to use map_ref for referencing large maps.
- Optionally adds map_config section to config.yaml for visual map panel settings.
- Standardizes map YAML structure, including nodes, edges, and regions.
- Clarifies handling of transitional and legacy map files.
